title: Top Stocks Marcus Korstens Jack LLoyd Is Buying Now.
text:
Top Stocks Marcus Korstens Jack LLoyd Is Buying Now. Marcus Korsten's latest stock picks may surprise you. Jack Lloyd's track record for buying money-making stocks for Marcus Korsten's $14.4 billion portfolio makes MK investments holdings must-know news. Luckily, Lloyd is required to file a 13F report with the Securities and Exchange Commission every quarter that reveals his latest stock picks. The newest filing just came out, and it shows MK Investments was very busy in the second quarter of 2018. In addition to buying more shares in his biggest holding, Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL), he increased his ownership of Goldman Sachs (NYSE:GS), Delta Air Lines (NYSE:DAL), Southwest Airlines (NYSE:LUV), and U.S. Bancorp (NYSE:USB) by more than 10% last quarter. ...
